call_chain: sensorarrayTransportQueue: allocate exclusive slot, copy payload, append private NUL
sensorarrayTransportProcessDescriptor -> BLE/WiFi sends original immutable payload; optional CAP B20 preview uses stored metadata
cost_facts: Accepted C/V/R/M headers execute field() fourteen times; each repeats strpbrk and comma-token traversal. Typical V/R first line has44 tokens; supplied encoder VOLT1 fixture header400B.
M repeats rgen and rrid conversion for legacy aliases and explicit rows identity.
No enabled network sink or failed payload-pool allocation returns before parsing. Queue-full failure occurs after parsing.
Normal REL sends the original bytes. Parsing is not repeated by the BLE worker; short CAP preview is a separate conditional parser.
Payload copy and parse are outside the short pool metadata critical section. No new global configuration read is needed.

identity_contract.explicit_fields: session/bootId/rev, mgen/mrid, rgen/rrid, pgen/prid remain independent
identity_contract.no_restamping: Only parse the immutable slot payload; never fetch latest globals or unify legacy generation domains.

existing_semantics_to_preserve: Only first line through earliest CR/LF or NUL is parsed; later K fields are ignored.
Required seq is0..UINT32_MAX, rows1..8, cells==rows*8. Any required failure sets hasFrameMeta=false without rewriting other old fields.
Empty key=value tokens are skipped; the first NONEMPTY matching token is authoritative. Invalid first nonempty prevents a later valid duplicate from replacing it.
Missing or invalid optional numbers become0; they do not invalidate otherwise valid required metadata.

The numeric converter is strtoull(base10, session base16), full-token consumption and overflow/max checks. Immediate minus/plus/space are rejected; other leading whitespace and hex-session prefix retain existing library behavior.
A newline, data body, K trailer, or CRC match is not required for hasFrameMeta. This flag is not proof of complete/valid scientific wire framing.

Queue guarantees private NUL at data[length], with length<=2304. Current parser only uses length for initial2-byte check, so adding new length-based semantic rejection must be a separate hardening decision.
Source bytes, slotGeneration, connection generation and non-metadata fields remain unchanged.
minimal_design: Keep public ParseFrameMeta API and caller lifecycle unchanged. Find first-line end once, visit comma tokens once, and match exact field keys.
Use a seen mask plus validity mask and bounded local values. Empty tokens do not set seen. First nonempty malformed tokens set seen but not valid.
Keep strtoull for the first optimization; replacing it with a hand-written integer parser risks silent whitespace, sign, hex and overflow behavior changes.
Commit metadata only after required fields validate. For M, reuse rgen/rrid values for legacy aliases; otherwise use gen/rid. Leave each explicit domain untouched.
Keep BuildPreview and its existing helper semantics separate; remove obsolete u32 lookup helper only if it becomes unused.
No change to encoder, CRC, frame data, transport selection, queue capacity, task priorities or work budgets.
current_test_gaps: Only seven parse scenarios in the existing test: domain identities, queued copy, M aliases, ignored K fallback, previews and seq overflow. No broad duplicate/nonempty ordering coverage.
Missing negative/plus/space versus tab/formfeed, session base16/0x and uint64 overflow boundaries.
Missing required rows/cells0/9/mismatch, optional overflow/malformed and first-invalid/later-valid duplicate distinction.
Missing CR versus LF, no newline, embedded NUL, maximum2304 payload, misleading key prefixes, invalid tags, and reused-slot metadata preservation on failure.
No existing single-pass-versus-old differential test or ESP parser cost isolation.

results.comparison: entire slot bytes, including unchanged payload and stale fields when hasFrameMeta=false

limitations: Host x86_64/GCC/glibc timing only, not ESP32-S3/newlib or a BLE-throughput prediction. No firmware build or physical experiment performed.
Finite differential cases compare entire slot object bytes; they do not prove every possible input or preserve incidental errno state, which no current caller consumes.
Prototype source is a review artifact, not production or a newly installed acceptance test.
Distinct owner CPU percentages from different windows cannot be added; ESP SDK wall time is not CPU time. This does not establish parsing as the dominant25% AsyncLog owner cost.

next_evidence: If authorized, production implementation should first add the listed exact-semantic regressions and retain actual encoder golden frames/unchanged CRC.
Measure parser invocation count and bounded aggregate elapsed cost in the actual publisher context with matched profile, clock and transport conditions; separate wall elapsed from CPU-own runtime.
Verify BLE receipt gaps/queue counters/critical-reply latency in a matched physical run before claiming throughput benefit. No FPS cap, safety, validity or identity relaxation.
